selection_rule: Cartesian product of every weekday in the closed date range and every listed local start time, ordered by date then time.
replacement_rule: No window is replaced after row counts, feasibility, runtime, or frontier outcomes are observed.
claim_boundary: A fixed outcome-blind public-data certification panel; not a probability sample, hidden-run recovery study, partner-recall benchmark, or Chicago population estimate.
declaration_context: Calendar-disjoint extension selected after observing the 24-window pilot. This campaign has not requested these follow-up windows before declaration; no pristine-holdout or population-sampling claim is made.

execution_plan.batch_order: Contiguous window indices, in the date/time order defined above.
execution_plan.reuse_rule: Retain every terminal scientific record; retry transport failures at the identical start time in a new attempt directory.
execution_plan.pending_rule: Never count an unstarted window as infeasible, ineligible, or a completed execution failure.

analysis_plan.comparison: Report the 24-window pilot and 96-window follow-up separately before any combined summary.
analysis_plan.dependence_rule: Parameter/query cells from one window are not independent observations; dates and time-of-day strata remain visible.
analysis_plan.scale_milestone: 120 predeclared calendar windows; not automatically 100 eligible cohorts, hundreds of independent cohorts, city-scale closure, or population validity.
analysis_plan.informativeness: Summarize frontier width and endpoint changes by declared support curve; any added threshold analysis requires its own frozen specification before follow-up outcomes are inspected.
analysis_plan.runtime_comparison: Report pilot and follow-up acquisition timings separately because transport changed.
